name: improvement-run
title: The improvement run, from the operator's seat: who supplies, who reads, who decides, and what is not built yet
description: The second thread of the product face: one improvement round as the operator walks it - the three planes and the relationship that bounds them, the seven steps, what the operator supplies and decides, the three instruments that do not exist, Experiment 0, the cost stated up front, and where the whole thing stands today. Plus one pointer to the file-as-API discipline in each of the two existing pages, so the first original requirement stops living only in a task document.
creator: aixi
